Identifiability of the cascade depth N and shapes a from T_N alone.

Source: R/identifiability.R
identifiability-overview.Rd

The cascade is additive in log-temperature, and its log-cumulants of order r>=2 identify the multiset {a_i} – hence N – without observing any intermediate level. See docs/theorems.md Theorem 3 (in the parent project) for the full derivation; the short version: writing the increment at level i as D_i = log T_i - log T_{i-1}, D_i is a function of the fresh per-level draw Y_i alone (independent of T_{i-1}), so the D_i are mutually independent and cumulants add.
